meta.name: REALISM_RULES
meta.purpose: Soft constraints per realismo pratico (volume, praticità, pattern)
meta.notes: Penalty soft: influenzano scoring senza proibire soluzioni. Apply only in realistic mode.

penalty_calibration.rationale: Penalty weights (0.8 per item, 0.6 per total) calibrated to guide solver without prohibiting solutions.
penalty_calibration.impact_range: At 600g single item: penalty ~1.6. At 800g total: penalty ~1.2. Max penalty ~3-4 in extreme cases.
penalty_calibration.why_these_values: 0.8 and 0.6 are strong enough to prefer fiber-dense alternatives (avena/fruit/nuts) over excessive veg, but weak enough to allow high veg when necessary (no alternatives available).
penalty_calibration.comparison_to_macro_error: Typical macro error ~2-5, so penalty 1-2 is significant but not dominant.
penalty_calibration.tuning_note: If solver still picks 600g+ veg when alternatives exist, increase weights. If solver avoids veg too aggressively, decrease.

notes_rules.volume_penalty_enabled: Se true, applica penalty volume veg in realistic mode
notes_rules.veg_penalty_per_100g_over_item: Penalty per ogni 100g oltre cap singolo item (score space)
notes_rules.veg_penalty_per_100g_over_total: Penalty per ogni 100g oltre cap totale (score space)
notes_rules.exclude_ingredients_from_volume: Se true, is_ingredient items (es. passata) non contano per volume
